Item entries are normalized by GameData::Item.get; Pokemon entries retain the same loaded object. The decode helper has no local rescue.
The reader accepts one Hash or the legacy sequence until EOF; conversion writeback and ordinary save open wb before Marshal.dump.

Marshal.load is the recovered builtin wrapper; it delegates actual deserialization to native marshal_load.
limits: Native object reconstruction format, malformed stream outcomes, actual file effects and full migration policy are outside the recovered wrapper.
